name: store-i18n
title: Localized Chrome Web Store screenshot series, all locales (v6, 5 slides)
style: v6 — five slides, rendered from JSON copy: 1 fullscreen hero, 2 personal dictionary, 3 guess/active recall, 4 customisation, 5 the built-in dictionary's word screen.
sourceOfTruth: assets/promo-copy.json — 54 locales, English is the per-field fallback

captures.note: Resolved per locale at run time, falling back to the English capture when a locale has not been captured. Only the English fallbacks are required up front. Capture from a PROD build (plain `vite build`, no EXT_ENV=dev) — a dev build paints a lime "backend: env" bar across the panel. IMPORTANT: the extension UI inside a capture is localized by demo mode's i18n override, NOT by Chrome's --lang (which does not change extension UI language). That override is generated by screenshots/gen-demo-ui.mjs from _locales/; run it and REBUILD before capturing, or the settings panel comes back in English while the rest is localized.

inputs.assetsNote: Two panel sheets, deliberately. Slide 1 uses fullscreen-panel.css (store-en@5's copy: enlarged captions); slide 3 uses fullscreen-panel-guess.css (fullscreen@1's copy). They are near-identical and it is tempting to merge them — don't: they carry different caption sizing. UPDATED 2026-09-20: they no longer differ in the .panel::before violet glow — it was ported into fullscreen-panel.css so slide 1 could have it. It stays OPT-IN in both (a slide draws it only by setting --glow-reach), so nothing that does not opt in changed.

outputs.note: The CWS autofill snippet reads the language from the folder directly containing screenshot-N.png, so <locale>/ must stay the last path segment. Point that snippet at out/store-i18n@5/. The series went 5 -> 4 in v5: a stale screenshot-5.png from an earlier run would be uploaded as a fifth slide showing the old design, so the renderer's output dir must be cleared of them.

knownIssues: SLIDE 1 HAS THE VIOLET GLOW, SLIDE 3 DOES NOT, and that asymmetry is measured rather than stylistic. The band left of the panel is 21% mean value on slide 1's studio and 91% on slide 3's blown-out window. A translucent layer over 91% can only SUBTRACT light, so a 'glow' there is arithmetically a shadow: rendered candidates measured -7 to -15 and read as a lilac stain on the photograph. Slide 3's panel needs no help anyway — light panel 231/255 against 209/255 for the frame, a 22-point separation on value alone. It keeps the violet EDGE only. Slide 1's glow is periwinkle #7C8DFF, not violet: it is the dark theme's own accent, the colour already lighting the active transcript row, and it sits 100° off the frame's magenta-red where violet sits 79° and reads as a continuation of the curtain.

THE HEADLINE ACCENT IS PINNED ON SLIDE 1, and the reason is a regression this cost. `--lime` does double duty: the headline's accent word AND the product's chip/toggle colour inside the panel. The dark theme redefines --lime to periwinkle so the panel agrees — which silently repainted the HEADLINE too, measured #C8FF00 before and #7C8DFF after, in every locale. fullscreen-slide.css now pins `body.warm .copy h1 .hl` back to lime. Scoped to body.warm so slide 5 — periwinkle BY DESIGN since v6 — is not caught by it.

PANEL THEME PER SLIDE (2026-09-20). Slide 1's panel is the product's DARK theme (panel-theme-dark.css) and slide 3's is the LIGHT one (panel-theme-light.css) — the reverse of what each frame's own sheet sets. Both slides rebuild the panel in HTML rather than cropping a capture, so this is a stylesheet swap and needs no recapture. Each theme sheet loads LAST. Ported from apps/rezka/promo/pipelines/store-i18n@1, where it was solved.

Product-UI strings drawn inside the rebuilt panel (its title, the mode chips, "N words saved") come from apps/youtube/_locales/<loc>/messages.json, read at render time — NOT from promo-copy.json. That is deliberate: a screenshot must never show a mode name the product does not use. It also means the panel text changes when _locales changes, with no re-render of the copy file needed.

The ORIGINAL transcript lines in the panel are Spanish in every locale (Spanish is the language being learned throughout the series); only the translation rows follow the locale. Slide 1 shows 8 such rows and slide 3 shows 2 — the rest stay masked by guess mode.

slide 2's overlay is positioned at RENDER time by placeOverlay() in render.mjs, which finds the lime active card in the capture and offsets from its top edge. It has to: the card sits at a different height per locale because a translation row that wraps to two lines pushes it down (measured y 371 for en/ru/de, 394 for id/sr/vi, 401 for kn/ta). The values it writes are PRE-SCALE — .stage .panel carries transform: scale(1.07), so rendered pixels must be divided by 1.07 before being written to style.top. Writing rendered pixels straight back moves the overlay 7% too far and silently breaks English, which was previously correct.

Slide 5 is the one slide whose captions and dictionary article are NOT localized. It reverses the series' language pair (the learner studies ENGLISH with Spanish as their own language) because the two elements it exists to show only exist for an English learning language: the Oxford button is gated on it in shape.ts, and the translations row only comes back for English headwords. Its marketing copy and its product-UI labels DO follow the locale.

v6 dropped slide 2's staged selection swatch and "+ Lingogram" pill, and with them placeOverlay() and check-overlay.mjs. The product removed that control in 1.0.21; the slide had gone on rendering it in CSS over the capture for three releases, green every time.

CAPTURE STALENESS, measured 2026-09-18 and NOT yet fixed: screenshots/out-live holds English captures re-shot on Sep 18 but 53 locales still from Aug 27 / Jul 14 — i.e. from before 1.0.21 removed the quick-add pill and shipped the saved-word mark. Slide 2 therefore renders correct in English and stale everywhere else: the old captures still show the green '+ saved' badge inside the picture, where no CSS of this pipeline can remove it. Re-capture before shipping the localized series: apps/youtube/screenshots/run-backdrop-all.sh (the backdrop path needs no live YouTube subtitles, so it does not risk the throttling the live path does).

Slide 5 is derived from the STATIC English page (pipelines/fullscreen@1/slide-word.html), so every product-UI string in it starts life as an English literal and has to be turned into a ${ui.*} hole by hand. Two were missed on the first pass — the Dual and On-screen labels in the mode row rendered English in all 54 locales while the back-chip beside them localized correctly. Anything copied from that page again needs the same check: a literal there is correct in English and wrong everywhere else.

verify.run: KEEP_BUILD=1 node pipelines/store-i18n@6/render.mjs   # then the two checks below
verify.check-overflow.mjs: no headline, paragraph, eyebrow, callout or caption may leave the 1280x800 canvas.
verify.check-orphans.mjs: no headline may end with an orphan — a last line under 25% of the widest. Line COUNT is not the test: ru slide 3 wraps to 5 lines and reads fine.
